newsitem.title: USA: DLB Oil buys Texaco stake.
newsitem.headline: DLB Oil buys Texaco stake.

text.p: DLB Oil & Gas Inc said Thursday it purchased, effective January 1, Texaco Inc's interest in some 4,600 producing acres in the West Cote Blanche Bay Field above the Rob "C" marker -- a geologic marker located at about 10,500 feet.

Texaco's interest above the Rob "C" marker in the subject leases was 50 percent. The purchase price is $12.5 million, adjusted for revenues and expenses since the effective date. An escrow fund designed to cover future abandonment obligations has also been established by DLB, it said.
DLB said it will operate over 400 existing wells and related production facilities which include oil and gas pipelines, salt water disposal wells, compression facilities and related equipment.

The West Cote Blanche Bay Field, located in St. Mary Parish, was discovered in 1940 and is one of the largest oil and gas fields in Louisiana. Average daily production is presently about 1,000 barrels of oil per day, or 400 barrels of oil per day, net to the acquired interest.
DLB said it will immediately commence a capital spending program to return non-producing wells to production, drill wells on undeveloped locations and expand production capacity.
